fields.summary: The district is amending its master contract with Alameda County Behavioral Health Care Services, under which the county pays the district up to $1,205,857 for the 2021-22 school year. The money supports Counseling Enriched Special Day Class services under students' Individualized Education Programs (IEPs). The new exhibits replace the old ones, and all other terms stay the same. The attached contract treats $1,205,857 as the full-year maximum for the term, not an add-on to an earlier amount.

21-2220.sourceIssue: The text states the county will provide $1,205,857 for the term but does not say whether this is added funding or the new full-year total under the amended contract; the attached contract treats it as the full-year maximum.
